name: Ripplejaw
lore: A stubborn river fish in a tideglass harness, determined to explore beyond the riverbank.

primary.name: Water Gun
primary.description: A short, narrow stream lands three 7-damage pulses over 0.24s. The first enemy or wall stops the stream.

secondary.name: Splish Splash
secondary.description: Splash nearby foes for 26 damage, leaving three small puddles for 4s. Enemies in puddles move 40% slower.

special.name: Below the Surface
special.description: Aim at a foe within 480. A dark shadow follows it at 75 speed for 1.6s, locks in place for 0.4s, then bites in a 100-radius area: 72 damage, a 1.25s stun and an inward pull. Bosses resist the pull. Targets can escape!

passive: Slippery Scales: Every third incoming moving projectile is deflected instead of hitting you. The returning shot deals 80% of its damage, capped at 30. Beams and explosions are not reflected.

technique.name: Lingering Tide
technique.description: Puddles last 6s and grow to 65 radius, but the initial splash deals 20 damage instead of 26.

final_technique.name: Shoal Whirlpool
final_technique.description: Replace the tracking bite with a fixed whirlpool at the aimed foe’s position. After 0.8s it pulls and slows for 3s, dealing six 10-damage ticks. Larger area, but no stun or tracking.

attack.name: Shoal Whirlpool
attack.description: A fixed 125-radius whirlpool wakes after 0.8s. Six 10-damage ticks pull and slow enemies. No bite stun.
